chapter: Appendix A: Review of Set Theory

items.inspection_target: Compare membership for operations and laws.
items.validation: Finite set equalities and symbolic Boolean checks.

items.concept: relations, generated equivalence relations, quotient classes, and partial orders
items.inspection_target: See equivalence classes as connected components and compare maximal with maximum.
items.validation: Reflexive, symmetric, transitive, partition, antisymmetric, and maximal-not-maximum checks.

items.concept: functions, images, preimages, fibers, injectivity, and surjectivity
items.inspection_target: Read fibers and why preimages preserve more set operations than images.
items.validation: Image/preimage identities and finite inverse-side tests.

items.concept: Cartesian products, indexed families, abstract disjoint unions, and quotient sets
items.inspection_target: Hover over tuples, tagged elements, and quotient fibers.
items.validation: Product cardinality, tagged disjoint-union cardinality, and quotient partition checks.

items.concept: countability of products and rational-number windows
items.inspection_target: Follow diagonal ranks through N x N and reduced fractions.
items.validation: Unique ranks, reduced fractions, and finite-window coverage checks.

items.inspection_target: Determine whether a downstream rule is constant on classes.
items.validation: Good map factors, bad map fails on a recorded fiber.
